title: Playboy's College Girls 1983 First Edition Newsstand Special Ivy League Pac 10
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete. See photos.
description:
Playboy's College Girls - the first College Girls newsstand special, 1983. Original $3.95 cover price (Canada $4.50, U.K. 3.25 pounds).

Girls of the Southwest Conference, Big Eight, Big Ten, Ivy League, Southeastern Conference and Pac 10. Back cover: "Major subjects from campuses across the country."

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
